title: Silence Datapack Warning
description: Turns the datapack validation warning into "Loading additional resources…", so it reads like normal loading, not an error.
body:
![Loading additional resources...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e12c70bf93c46687d36dbd51e98848797b48831.png)
This resource pack for Minecraft provides a purely cosmetic tweak to the datapack validation messages that may briefly appear during world creation. It replaces the relevant validation and failure text (including the failure screen) with "Loading additional resources...", so it feels like a normal content-loading step rather than an alarming warning.

It does not change gameplay, disable datapack checks, or fix broken datapacks - this is cosmetic text replacement only. Use it if you already know the warning is harmless in your setup and you want a cleaner, less intrusive presentation for you and your players.
